verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a UI-driven local app: drop in a reference on the home page, chat in the right-hand panel, comment on the video and use the Production line tab. No programmatic API is documented, let alone one matching the UI. The only command-line items are a single `post-video` publishing command and an `npm run doctor` setup check, which are adjacent features and do not show API parity with the UI.
